domain.relationships: vertices numbered 1 through N; no self-loops or repeated unordered edges

input.format: N M S T on the first line, then M lines of u v; each edge connects u and v in both directions

state.mutable: current vertex and number of traversed edges

actions.preconditions: an undirected edge connects the current vertex and the next vertex
actions.transition: move to the adjacent vertex and add 1 to the distance
actions.reuse: vertices and edges may be revisited; every traversal costs 1
actions.resources: all edge costs are exactly 1; no other resource restriction

goal.definition: number of edges in a walk from S to T

termination: reach T; output -1 if no path exists

output.ties: print the minimum distance only, not a path
output.empty: S equals T: output 0, even when there are no edges
output.impossible: output -1 when T is unreachable from S

limits.executionConstraints: 1 <= S,T,u,v <= N; u != v; unordered edge pairs are unique

obligations.smallDomain: N <= 4; compare all-pairs shortest paths independently
obligations.stress: N=100 chain and N=100 M=200 graph
mutants: unreachable distance incorrectly returned as zero
